cover: Inheriting a codebase that still works

slides.title: Nothing was broken
slides.body: The site worked. Underneath, every fragile part was holding something up, so every change felt risky.

slides.title: The first month shipped nothing
slides.body: We made the system runnable, deployable and reproducible before touching a feature.

slides.title: Every rebuild had a reason
slides.body: Search engines couldn't see the pages, a framework was nearing end of support, and editors waited on a developer.

slides.title: Every step could be undone
slides.body: The old API stayed running, rollback was one setting, and the migration copied without deleting.

slides.title: A site that publishes itself
slides.body: 352 static pages. Editors hit publish, the site rebuilds, and a broken build never reaches production.
